taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1874 | 2.78 | 2.78
2 | 2428 | 9.13 | 11.9
3 | 1071 | 15.2 | 27.1
4 | 3706 | 32.2 | 59.3
5 | 178 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AAK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Kenpoly-sec-school-field, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Kenpoly-sec-school-field, Bori Metropolis**

The interpreted VES model comprises five layers. Resistivity decreases from 1874 Ω·m (layer 1) to 2428 Ω·m (layer 2), drops sharply to 1071 Ω·m (layer 3), rises again to 3706 Ω·m (layer 4), and falls to 178 Ω·m (layer 5), the latter interpreted as the basal/conductive unit. Depths to base range from 2.78 m to 59.3 m, with layer 5 unterminated (assumed infinite half-space).

Checking the resistivity sequence against standard curve-type rules: layers 1-2-3 give r1<r2>r3 (K), layers 2-3-4 give r2>r3<r4 (H), and layers 3-4-5 give r3<r4>r5 (K). This yields a KHK-type curve, not the AAK-type recorded in the file. The filed classification does not match the tabulated resistivity values and should be corrected before further geohydrological interpretation.

{"curve_type_stated": "AAK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
